lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] {V : E → ℝ} {κ : NNReal},
  1 ≤ κ →
    ContDiff ℝ 2 V →
      (∀ (x v : E), (↑κ)⁻¹ * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x) v) v ∧ ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x) v) v ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2) →
        ∀ {eta c eps : ℝ},
          0 < eta →
            eta ≤ c →
              c < 1 →
                0 < eps →
                  have T := fun y x => y - eta • gradient V x;
                  have F := fun y x => V x + eta⁻¹ / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2;
                  ∃ p N,
                    Measurable p ∧
                      Measurable N ∧
                        (Measurable fun y => (T y)^[N y] y) ∧
                          ∀ (y : E),
                            p y + eta • gradient V (p y) = y ∧
                              (∀ (z : E),
                                  F y (p y) + ((↑κ)⁻¹ + eta⁻¹) / 2 * ‖z - p y‖ ^ 2 ≤ F y z ∧
                                    (F y z ≤ F y (p y) ↔ z = p y)) ∧
                                ‖(T y)^[N y + 1] y - (T y)^[N y] y‖ ≤ (1 - eta) * eps ∧
                                  (∀ j < N y, ¬‖(T y)^[j + 1] y - (T y)^[j] y‖ ≤ (1 - eta) * eps) ∧
                                    ‖(T y)^[N y] y - p y‖ ≤ eps ∧
                                      ↑(N y) + 1 ≤
                                          (2 + (1 + Real.log (1 - c)⁻¹) / -Real.log c) *
                                            (1 + Real.log (1 + ‖gradient V y‖ / eps)) ∧
                                        Q (gradient V) eta eps y (N y + 1) y = some ((T y)^[N y] y, N y + 1)
approved_definition_context: Q has type (E→E)→R→R→E→N→E→Option(E×N). It is a noncomputable exact-real recursive interpreter. Q g eta eps y 0 x = none. At fuel n+1, set z=y−eta•g(x). If ‖z−x‖≤(1−eta)*eps, return some(x,1); otherwise map (u,k)↦(u,k+1) over Q g eta eps y n z. This recurrence records output and count, not a query-list trace.
Function iteration f^[n] denotes n-fold composition, with f^[0] the identity. NNReal denotes nonnegative reals, coerced to reals by the displayed upward arrow.

ContDiff R 2 means twice continuously differentiable. fderiv is the totalized Frechet derivative; the displayed regularity hypothesis ensures it represents the genuine derivative. gradient denotes the real inner-product gradient.
Measurable uses the displayed Borel structure on E and the standard measurable structure on natural numbers. N:E→N and p:E→E in the existential quantifier.
